current_task: Implement bounded browser main/clock/sleep/lifecycle and remove original duplicate callback stubs.
summary: Added platform/doomgeneric_runtime.c integrating supplied doomgeneric_Create and doomgeneric_Tick without engine edits.

DG_GetTicksMs uses monotonic emscripten_get_now and milliseconds (initial offset 1 avoids engine zero sentinel). DG_SleepMs directly yields via Asyncify even in engine tic synchronization and screen wipes.

Single sequential infinite main continuation prevents scheduled tick reentrancy; an extra 1 ms outer yield covers fast-returning ticks. Engine retains authority over 35 Hz simulation via its unmodified TICRATE conversion.
Startup argument pointer array and strings are copied to lifetime heap storage before Create; duplicate main entry is a no-op.
All original doomgeneric_wasm.c callback stubs removed; video/input/title remain solely in video_input.c.
Emscripten 4.0.18 integrated build and native development test pass.
